lines.text: This is TapeTape: the encrypted messenger built on TapeOut, with no server and its own X Layer wallet.
Its DeWEB browser opens sites by their on-chain name.
Type 5.2.212, and Voxro loads straight from X Layer. No web server, no hosting.
lines.say: Type five, dot two, dot two-one-two, and Voxro loads straight from X Layer. No web server, no hosting.

lines.text: Every file is read from the chain and checked against its hash.
Connect with TapeTape's built-in wallet. One tap, no extension, nothing to import.
Find anyone with a Voxro inbox. @gsucoin charges 1 USD₮0 to reach them.
lines.say: Find anyone with a Voxro inbox. G S U coin charges one U S D T zero to reach them.

lines.text: A TapeOut circuit sets the price, and if they don't reply in time, you get it all back.
TapeTape's own status page shows every file verified against the chain, and no off-chain references.
TapeTape for people you know. Voxro for people you don't.
